title: Table 1 Between-process comparisons of regional differences.
note: Note. Each region included 42,000 players, and each regional contrast involved 84,000 players. Δ denotes the adjusted mean in the first region minus that in the second. Means for all three regions were estimated under the same reference conditions, with equal weights across tiers and, separately, across positions. Game patches were weighted by their proportions in the pooled analysis sample, and match duration was fixed at that sample’s mean. Maintenance and signalling retained their respective full-sample standardized scoring scales. ΔM − ΔS was calculated from unrounded joint estimates; positive values indicate a larger regional adjusted mean difference for maintenance. Pointwise 95% confidence intervals were obtained from 1,000 resamples of players within region × tier strata, using joint first-order updates to preserve the covariance between processes. P values correspond to two-sided Wald tests of ΔM − ΔS and were Holm-adjusted within a family of 12 tests comprising nine regional comparisons of the overall or process scores and three between-process contrasts.
